# Arial Gamer

> Arial Gamer is an independent mobile game studio from Brazil. Short, joyful games for iPhone and Android, with no ads, no sign-up and no data collection, in 8 languages (English, Portuguese, Spanish, German, French, Italian, Japanese and Chinese). Website: https://arialgamer.com.br/

## Games
- [Deicida](https://arialgamer.com.br/en/deicida/): cinematic hack and slash, a mortal against the gods of 11 mythologies. Free on Android; iPhone coming soon.
- [Rota Estelar](https://arialgamer.com.br/en/rota-estelar/): family space shooter through 31 real planets, giant bosses and 10 ships. iPhone; Android coming soon.
- [Vôlei Total](https://arialgamer.com.br/en/volei-total/): arcade volleyball, 6v6 indoor and 2v2 beach, Super Spike, 2 players on one phone. iPhone; Android coming soon.
- [Gol de Placa](https://arialgamer.com.br/en/gol-de-placa/): 3D penalties and free kicks, be the kicker or the goalkeeper, online with a friend. iPhone; Android coming soon.
- [Xodó](https://arialgamer.com.br/en/xodo/): 90s keychain virtual pet with Brazilian animals (capybara, tamarin, armadillo). It never dies. iPhone; Android coming soon.
- [Esconde-Esconde](https://arialgamer.com.br/en/esconde-esconde/): hide and seek in 24 places, against the computer or a friend. iPhone and Android.
- [Gelada](https://arialgamer.com.br/en/gelada/): virtual beer and cocktail simulator, tilt the phone to drink, 100 drinks. iPhone and Android.

## Apps
- [Acervo: Your Collection](https://arialgamer.com.br/en/acervo/): catalog and value collections (watches, coins, stamps, vinyl, trading cards).
